messages:
maria: Heads up — PR #4523 is red on CI. Build step succeeded, but smoke-tests/* failed (flaky?). Can someone kick a quick rerun that avoids rebuilding the docker image?
ci-bot: buildkite: job "smoke-tests" failed on agent 7. Logs: https://ci.example.com/builds/4523/jobs/8723 :warning:
alex: @maria you can restart just the failed job from the CI UI, or with the CLI: 
alex: ```bash
# buildkite: restart only the failed steps for a build
bk restart --build 4523 --steps smoke-tests
# OR set env to skip image build on retry
SKIP_IMAGE_BUILD=1 bk restart --build 4523 --steps smoke-tests
```
jen: if you use the UI, pick "rebuild failed steps" — that won't touch the image build. :+1:
sam: another option for GitHub Actions (if anyone's on it) is: 
Sam: ```bash
gh run rerun 123456789 --failed
```
li: quick tip — check the failure log for timeouts. If it looks like flake, rerun once, if it repros 2x then bisect.
maria: thanks. I'm seeing this stack: `tests/smoke/login_test.py::test_sso_redirect` — looks like a network blip. I'll rerun once.
ci-bot: buildkite: queued restart for build 4523 (steps: smoke-tests) — started on agent 12.
alex: if the restart keeps failing and it's only that test, we can run locally with the same fixtures: 
alex: ```bash
pytest tests/smoke/login_test.py::test_sso_redirect -k 'smoke' -q
```
jen: also consider adding flaky marker or increasing timeout if we see this a lot. open a quick issue if it flakes > 3 times.
maria: rerun finished — green. Deploy looks safe. Thanks for the quick help everyone. :rocket:
nate: noted — I'll add the test to the flaky-tracking dashboard (metric alert if >2 failures in 24h).
li: if anyone wants a short checklist for future, here's the minimal triage we use: 
li: 1) confirm build vs test failure; 2) restart failed steps (no image build); 3) inspect logs; 4) reproduce locally; 5) bisect or mark flaky.
maria: saving that checklist — will open a follow-up to either increase timeout or add network stub for this test.
jen: great, thanks all. :tada:
